en.headline: AIIB expresses interest in financing Northern Metropolis projects
en.dek: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank is keen on infrastructure development in the Northern Metropolis and will explore cooperation when specific projects are identified.
body: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank has expressed interest in financing projects in Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis, Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po said on Sunday.

Speaking on a radio programme, Chan said AIIB officials told the government they were very interested in infrastructure development in the 30,000-hectare plan bordering the mainland, as it matches the bank's expertise.

Chan also noted that global finance leaders set aside political differences during last week's APEC finance ministers' meeting in Hong Kong and reached consensus on promoting digital infrastructure, employment and youth exchange. The Northern Metropolis is intended as a technology and housing hub.
The government has previously said the project will integrate technology, industry and talent. No specific funding agreements have been announced.

zh.headline: 亞投行有興趣為北部都會區項目提供融資
zh.dek: 財政司司長陳茂波表示，亞洲基礎設施投資銀行對北部都會區基建發展甚有興趣，當有具體項目時會探討合作方式。
body: 亞洲基礎設施投資銀行對香港北部都會區項目表示有興趣提供融資，財政司司長陳茂波周日表示。
陳茂波在電台節目說，亞投行官員向政府表示，對毗鄰內地的三萬公頃計劃中的基建發展非常有興趣，因為這正是銀行的專長。他說：「他們告訴我們，如果有任何北部都會區項目開放共同投資，他們會非常有興趣。當有具體項目時，我們會探討合作方式。」
陳茂波亦提到，上周在香港舉行的亞太經合組織財長會議上，全球金融領袖擱置政治分歧，就推動數碼基建、就業及青年交流達成共識。北部都會區旨在成為科技及房屋樞紐。
政府早前表示，該項目將整合科技、產業及人才。目前尚未公布具體融資協議。
